rationale: Independent reading: EO 12759 (56 FR 16257) federal energy management, no own end term. EO 12902 partially revoked it (secs. 3, 9, 10 saved) but that record is APP-derived and not used. Held EO 13123 (64 FR 30851) sec. 604: 'Executive Order 12902 ..., Executive Order 12759 of April 17, 1991, and Executive Order 12845 ... are revoked', unqualified; no savings clause for EO 12759 found in the held text. Named whole revocation ends the surviving sections. I agree: NO.
